dict.string: x5desk finds your Insta360 camera over Bluetooth, wakes it, pairs with it and sets up its Wi-Fi.
x5desk talks to your Insta360 camera over its Wi-Fi network and streams to RTMP servers on your local network.
x5desk lists and imports the recordings on your camera's card when it is connected as a disk.
x5desk opens recordings, projects and music you keep in your Documents folder.
x5desk opens recordings you keep in your Downloads folder, and downloads from the camera there if you choose it.
x5desk opens recordings, projects and music you keep on your Desktop.
